24/S0.subgoal: Explain the categorization of users into novice, intermittent, and expert groups and why this classification is important for system design.

24/S1.subgoal: Describe different design perspectives and how a software development lifecycle can be used to address user characteristics.

24/S2.subgoal: Describe the definition, key aspects, and measures of usability based on ISO standards.

24/S3.subgoal: Describe the concept of user-centered design and its related terms in the context of interactive systems.

24/S4.subgoal: Explain how the principles of interactive systems and user-centered design apply specifically to extended reality (XR) systems.

24/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
